info.title: About EgoCast
info.about: EgoCast is a weather advisory app. It turns the forecast for your location into short, personality-driven advice, such as what to wear and whether to take an umbrella, in a tone you choose: Classic, Mom or Angry Bro.
info.signIn: Signing in with Google is optional. We use your Google name, email and profile picture only to recognise you when you come back.
